item.title: Walk Softly, Speak Quietly, Smile Sweetly - Is That the Motto of Pregnancy?
item.description: Smiling sweetly? Yes! But walking softly and speaking quietly? Not necessarily. Staying physically active is incredibly important during pregnancy. Unless you have a medical condition or a risk of miscarriage, keeping up with regular exercise that suits your stage of pregnancy can help ease symptoms like back pain and fatigue, while also building flexibility and strength for labor.
